title: Install a commit under test from a GitHub codeload tarball instead of a git+ URL
answers: install mlflow from a GitHub commit in CI without fetching full git history
uv git+ requirement is slow in the installation check
pin a GitHub archive tarball URL for uv --with at a commit SHA
build-wheel installation test timing out or flaking on git backend
body:
- Build the URL as https://github.com/${REPO}/archive/${REF}.tar.gz, with REF set to the exact commit (`git rev-parse HEAD`), not a branch name.
- Append `#subdirectory=libs/<name>` for a sub-package. The root project gets no fragment. In build-wheel.yml the fragment comes from MATRIX_TYPE: "dev" means root, any other value becomes `libs/${MATRIX_TYPE}`, so matrix values must match libs/ directory names.
- Reason: uv fetches full repository history for `git+` requirements. The PR reports 33-43s with git+ versus 19-30s with the tarball, and git+ was more exposed to transient Git backend failures.
- Keep the 3-attempt retry loop and wrap each attempt in `timeout -k 10 120`. The 120s bound matches the observed runtime; the old 240s only delayed retries.
- Applies to the GitHub-hosted wheel install check. The tarball is a snapshot of one commit, so it is not a moving-branch install.
applies: Install checks in GitHub Actions that need to install an unreleased MLflow commit or subpackage with uv; not for installs that need a published release from PyPI.
says: Package installation step in continuous integration runs too slowly during pull request validation.
Wheel verification builds frequently time out while downloading repository snapshots for testing.
Speed up automated test pipeline checks that install unreleased commits.
Build validation job fails intermittently due to transient repository download timeouts.
search: GitHub Actions wheel install checks in .github/workflows/build-wheel.yml install unreleased MLflow commits or subpackages using GitHub codeload archive tarball URLs rather than git+ URLs. The URL format is https://github.com/${REPO}/archive/${REF}.tar.gz using git rev-parse HEAD for REF, with #subdirectory=libs/<name> appended according to MATRIX_TYPE matching libs/ directory names. This avoids uv fetching full git history, mitigating slow runs and Git backend failures while retaining a three-attempt retry loop bounded by timeout -k 10 120. Applies only to unreleased commit checks in GitHub Actions, not moving-branch installs or published PyPI releases.
